chargers.description: Connectors & power specs are provisioned by Admin — read-only. You can edit the display name and status. Click a row to view details.

panel.idHelp: Unique ID used to generate check-in QR — cannot be changed.
panel.nameHelp: This name is displayed to drivers and on the charger screen.
panel.specHelp: Connectors and power capacity are assigned by Admin during installation.
panel.qrHelp: Affix onto charger for drivers to scan on arrival.

pricing.title: Pricing & Hours
pricing.subtitle: Base price, TOU time-slots, and operating hours. Changes only apply to new bookings.
pricing.saveSuccess: Saved pricing and operating hour configurations

step1.title: Basic Config
step1.groupHelp: Set the minimum duration for each charging session.
step1.basePriceHelp: This price applies to any time slots not explicitly configured below.

step2.title: Operating Hours
step2.helpText: Operating hours affect your station's visibility on the drivers' search map.

step3.title: TOU Pricing
step3.noRules: No custom time-slots defined — all bookings will use base price. Click Add Time-slot to start.
step3.tipText: Increasing prices during the 18:00 – 21:00 slot could boost monthly revenue by up to 15%.

step4.title: Availability Rules
step4.lockDesc: Release slots after 15 mins if the driver does not check in.
step4.advanceDesc: How far in advance drivers can book a slot.
step4.validConfigHelp: All time slots verified and have no overlaps.

addRule.title: Add Time-slot
addRule.subtitle: Define custom rates that apply to bookings within this time slot.
addRule.validationError: Please input a valid rule name, price, and time-slot (HH:mm).

register.subtitle: Submission remains in PENDING status until evaluated by an administrator.
register.nameHelp: This name is shown to drivers searching on the map.
register.addressHelp: Used to pin your station accurately on the search map.
register.licenseHelp: Business licenses are verified off-platform prior to approval (do not upload files here).

license.title: License
license.subtitle: Status of your operational license.
license.helpBody: Purchasing/renewing licenses is handled off-platform; statuses are updated manually by administrators. This page is read-only.
license.warningBody: The station and all its chargers will be hidden from driver searches until renewed (BR-STA-01). Active, ongoing sessions will not be affected.
